## Shape 3: Quadrilateral (Right-side)
Tracing the connected segments: (10.14295,18.42605) → (12.34075,19.60237) → ... → (33.77773,39.1573) → ... → (19.67117,31.60713) → (6.55706,16.5068) → (10.14295,18.42605)

- Side from (6.55706, 16.5068) to (10.14295, 18.42605): direction (3.59, 1.92)

Ratio check: -14.11/3.59 = -3.93 and -7.55/1.92 = -3.93 ✓ (Anti-parallel, same ratio)

The other pair of opposite sides are NOT parallel. This is a **trapezoid with exactly one pair of parallel sides** and **no diagonals** drawn.

✓ **Option 6: Trapezoid (one pair of parallel sides, no diagonals)**
